dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit high-contrast, serrated dark perimeters transitioning sharply to lighter, low-intensity interior regions across the dorsal and lateral surfaces.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, solid low-intensity dark spots lacking internal gradients, clustered primarily in the anterior dorsal and lower lateral regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest mid-lateral annuli form an elongated scalene triangle, while a group of four dark blobs on the anterior dorsal surface form an irregular quadrilateral.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent 'figure-8' shape formed by two intersecting macro-annuli is visible in the mid-posterior dorsal region.
